items.title: The Philippines and Australia strengthen joint military deterrence at ASEAN summit
items.summary: Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippine capital Manila on Sunday. During three days, world leaders are expected to focus on trade, energy and conflict – including the war in Iran. Donald Trump is expected to land in Manila on Tuesday. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Bangkok Tommy Walker.

conflicts.name: Serbien–Kosovo
conflicts.background: Wiederkehrende Spannungen im serbisch geprägten Norden Kosovos; Dialogprozess der EU festgefahren.

items.title: Kosovo Ex-President’s Second Sentence Revives Controversy over Hague Court
items.summary: Already found guilty of war crimes, Hashim Thaci’s second guilty verdict – for attempting to interfere with witnesses – has raised new questions about the court that was set up in The Hague in a bid to avoid such intimidation attempts.

items.title: Vukovar Remembers 1991 Victims as Croatia Renews Call for Serbia’s Cooperation
items.summary: Tens of thousands join annual Remembrance Procession, as Croatian officials urge Serbia's new government to provide information on fate of people still missing from 1991–1995 war.

items.title: Kosovo’s Thaci Found Guilty of Trying to Obstruct Justice in War Crimes Case
items.summary: Following his conviction for war crimes in September, Thaci was found guilty again, this time for attempting to obstruct justice by witness-tampering.

items.title: Second Trial of Kosovo’s Thaci, for Obstructing Justice, Nears End
items.summary: Verdict looms on Tuesday in former President Hashim Thaci's second trial at The Hague, in which he is accused of interfering with witnesses in the earlier war-crimes case against him.

items.title: Hashim Thaci's second conviction in The Hague reignites debate in Kosovo about justice and the Kosovo Specialist Chambers
items.summary: Former President Hashim Thaci has been convicted of trying to influence witnesses in his war crimes trial. The conviction has reignited debate in Kosovo about the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, the court that convicted him.

conflicts.name: Bosnien-Herzegowina
conflicts.background: Sezessionsdruck aus der Republika Srpska belastet die Dayton-Ordnung; EUFOR-Präsenz verstärkt.

items.title: Republika Srpska Ban on 1990s Bosnian Army Symbols Ruled Unconstitutional
items.summary: The state-level Constitutional Court ruled against Republika Srpska’s law changes introducing prison terms for displaying flags or symbols of the Bosniak-led 1990s wartime army that fought against Serb forces.

items.title: Prison Release Plea for Besieger of Sarajevo Rejected Yet Again
items.summary: The UN court has denied wartime Bosnian Serb Army officer Dragomir Milosevic’s early release request for a fourth time, citing a lack of ‘sufficient signs’ of rehabilitation.

conflicts.name: Ägypten / Sinai
conflicts.background: Weitgehend eingedämmter Aufstand im Nordsinai; Ägypten unter Druck durch den Gaza-Krieg und die Rafah-Grenze.

items.title: Egypt: Ethiopian Army Chief Accuses Egypt of Supporting TPLF As Fighting Resumes
items.summary: [Shabelle] Addis Ababa, Ethiopia -- Ethiopia's military chief, Field Marshal Birhanu Jula, has accused Egypt of providing military and logistical support to the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) as fighting between federal forces and Tigrayan fighters intensifies.
